content.title: 2026 PGA TOUR on CBS: Schedule And How to Watch Live Golf
content.text: Icon Sportswire via Getty Images 2026 marks CBS Sports’ 69th consecutive year of offering live PGA TOUR play. The network teed off its schedule with live coverage of the Third and Final rounds of the Farmers Insurance Open, and it’ll keep delivering live play, in-depth analysis, and panoramic course views through more than a dozen events – all the way through the TOUR Championship in August. Read on to get the 2026 PGA TOUR schedule as presented by CBS Sports. Learn how to watch and stream live play, and find out where the 2026 Masters fits into the picture. When is the 2026 Masters? The 2026 Masters Tournament takes place Thursday, April 9, through Sunday, April 12, 2026, at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia. Along with the U.S. Open, the PGA Championship, and The Open Championship, the Masters is one of men’s golf’s four major tournaments. Rory McIlroy is the reigning champ. CBS will deliver coverage throughout this year’s tournament. It’ll air highlights from the First Round and Second Round, and present 14 hours of live weekend play from the Third Round and Final Round across CBS and Paramount+ (various plans), plus offer live feeds from all four days of the event, from Thursday-Sunday, that’ll be available to watch on Paramount+ (all plans), CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports app. How to watch the PGA TOUR live on CBS You can watch events from the PGA TOUR schedule live on CBS on your TV or device tuned to your local CBS station by using cable, satellite, live-TV streaming service, or digital antenna. How to stream the PGA TOUR live on Paramount+ When events from the PGA TOUR schedule are airing live on CBS, you can stream them live on Paramount+ with a subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan – no cable required. How can I watch CBS Sports’ live coverage of the PGA TOUR on my phone or mobile device? When you have an active Paramount+ subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan, you can watch CBS Sports’ live coverage of the events from the PGA TOUR schedule on your phone or mobile device via the Paramount+ app or ParamountPlus.com. The Paramount+ app is available on the Apple App Store or Google Play: iPhone or iPad: Paramount+ on App Store Android Phone or Tablet: Paramount+ on Google Play Visit the Paramount+ Help Center for supported devices, or see below for the list, and then sign up and get started.
